tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_void_spirit_aether_: Void Spirit dispatches a remnant to the target location. The remnant stands watch over the region, facing the direction of his vector. When a unit crosses its gaze, the remnant pulls it in and damages it.
Inai exists far beyond the scope of a single point in space and time.

Creates an additional watcher path that rotates around the remnant.  The remnant now provides True Sight, and no longer triggers on creeps, instead dealing %creep_damage_pct%%% damage to them every second in both paths. Does not reveal wards.

tokens.npc_dota_hero_void_spirit_bio:
Not even the other spirits claim to understand the mind and machinations of the eldest amongst them, Inai the Void Spirit. Privy to secrets that would shatter a mortal mind, the Void Spirit observes the workings of the universe from an unknowable vantage, choosing to let carefully groomed servants do his bidding -- only emerging from his Hidden Temple into the material plane when he deems that he alone can steer the course of reality along its proper path.

With an expansive perspective on existence, Inai is focused intently on a point in time beyond which he cannot see, when the fabrics of multiple realities are fated to collide. Now he steps from the aether to personally resolve the battle of the Ancients and prepare his allies for what he views as a greater conflict to come.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_void_spirit_hype: Privy to secrets that would shatter a mortal mind, the Void Spirit emerges from his Hidden Temple to stand guard over multiple areas of the battlefield at once. Able to step into and out of the mortal plane at will, he easily outmaneuvers opponents to strike from wherever he desires, calling upon the powers of the aether to shield him in times of need.

qualifications.raw:
* The ability effects are applied as follows:
** {{Symbol|Teleport}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* The ability has two [[area-of-effect]] components:
** [[File:Dota2 Void Spirit Aether Remnant Formation icon.png|315x105px|]]
*** Upon cast, the remnant moves to the {{Symbol|Target|Point}} point-targeted location [[File:Dota2 Letter-o.png|21px|O]] at {{#var:Aether Remnant value1}}-speed, then {{M|facing angle|text=faces}} the {{Symbol|Target|Vector}} vector-targeted direction.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|1|21px]] [[File:Dota2 Void Spirit Aether Remnant Dummy Vision icon.png|84px|]] {{Symbol|Facing Angle|r}}
*** Grants the following bonuses upon reaching its {{Symbol|Target|Point}} point-targeted location, centered around point [[File:Dota2 Letter-o.png|21px|O]]:
**** Radius [[File:Dota2 Letter-b.png|21px|B]] has {{#var:Aether Remnant basic1}}-radius {{M|vision|text=ground vision}}.
**** Radius [[File:Dota2 Letter-r.png|21px|R]] has {{Symbol|bonus shd}} {{ValueColor||{{#var:Aether Remnant value5 shd}}|shd}} {{M|True Sight}} radius.
***** {{cf|shdnotes}} The {{M|Aghanim's Shard|text=ability upgrade}} does not immediately update the current remnants.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|2|21px]]
*** {{#var:Aether Remnant value4}} seconds after casting, the remnant activates the following ability components:
**** {{Symbol|Vision|Flying}}
***** [[File:Dota2 Void Spirit Aether Remnant Vision (Activate) icon-1.png|105px|]][[File:Dota2 Void Spirit Aether Remnant Vision (Activate) icon-2.png|105px|]][[File:Dota2 Void Spirit Aether Remnant Vision (Activate) icon-3.png|105px|]]
****** Grants 2 consecutive {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{#var:Aether Remnant value3}}-width and {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{#expr:{{#var:Aether Remnant type1 value1}}/2}}-length [[flying vision]] cells.
******* Vision cell [[File:Dota2 Letter-s.png|21px|S]] [[File:Dota2 Letter-q.png|21px|Q]] and [[File:Dota2 Letter-q.png|21px|Q]] [[File:Dota2 Letter-p.png|21px|P]] are {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{#expr:{{#var:Aether Remnant type1 value1}}/2}}-distance and {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{#var:Aether Remnant type1 value1}}-distance respectively in front of the remnant.
******* Hence, the total vision area-of-effect is [[Wikipedia:Stadium (geometry|stadium]]-shaped-like with {{#expr:{{#var:Aether Remnant value3}}+{{#var:Aether Remnant type1 value1}}}}-distance from the remnant.
**** {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
***** [[File:Dota2 Void Spirit Aether Remnant Search (Activate) icon-1.png|105px|]][[File:Dota2 Void Spirit Aether Remnant Search (Activate) icon-2.png|105px|]][[File:Dota2 Void Spirit Aether Remnant Search (Activate) icon-3.png|105px|]]
****** Has an enemy search range akin to the vision cell [[File:Dota2 Letter-s.png|21px|S]] [[File:Dota2 Letter-q.png|21px|Q]] and [[File:Dota2 Letter-q.png|21px|Q]] [[File:Dota2 Letter-p.png|21px|P]] with the same {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{#var:Aether Remnant type1 value1}}-length and {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{#var:Aether Remnant value2}}-width. 
***** The remnant applies the following ability effects to the furthest enemy unit closest to line [[File:Dota2 Letter-s.png|21px|S]] [[File:Dota2 Letter-p.png|21px|P]] :
****** {{M|Cannot act}}.
****** Grants {{M|True Sight}} over it, but does not reveal {{I|Observer and Sentry Wards}}.
****** {{M|Unobstructed movement}}.
****** {{M|fear|text=Hypnosis}} with a [[Movement Speed#Set Movement Speed|set]] {{M|movement speed}}. This is defined as:
******* {{cf|expr}} {{Code|[[Wikipedia:Absolute_value|{{!}}]] RemnantPosition - TargetPosition [[Wikipedia:Absolute_value|{{!}}]] × {{#var:Aether Remnant type1 value3}}}}
******* The set value does not adapt after the remnant proc.
******* {{Symbol|fx|v}}
******** Visually pulls the affected enemy hero toward the remnant.
****** Considers enemy {{M|clones}}, {{M|illusions}}, {{M|creep-heroes}}, and {{M|summons}} as heroes.
**** {{cf|shdnotes}} [[File:Dota2 Anticlockwise.png|31px|Anticlockwise]]
***** The additional watcher path starts rotating anticlockwise in {{#expr:360/{{#var:Aether Remnant type2 value1 shd}}}}° per second upon cast, and completes a max {{#expr:{{#var:Aether Remnant type1 value5}}/{{#var:Aether Remnant type2 value1 shd}} round2}} orbits over the entire duration.

* {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
** {{Symbol|Move Speed}}
*** The affected enemy hero stops moving within {{#var:Aether Remnant basic2}}-distance of the remnant, then the remnant disappears.
*** {{Symbol|Trees}}
**** [[Trees]] within 200-radius centered around the affected enemy hero at this point.
** {{Symbol|Lane Creeps}}
*** The remnant applies the following ability effects on [[lane creeps]] or {{M|neutral creeps}} after the remnant activation delay, then disappears.
***# The {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}} upon proc.
***# The {{M|fear|text=Hypnosis}}, albeit not being noticeable.
*** {{cf|shdnotes}} {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|void_spirit_aether_remnant_creep_damage}}
**** Applies the {{M|spell damage}} debuff to creeps for the remnant's remaining duration, and no longer disappears upon proc.
**** Deals {{ValueColor||{{calc|v1*{{#var:Aether Remnant type3 value1 shd}}|v1={{#var:Aether Remnant type1 value2}}}}|shd}} ({{Symbol|bonus t2l}} {{ValueColor||{{calc|v1*{{#var:Aether Remnant type3 value1 shd}}|v1={{#var:Aether Remnant type1 value2 tal}}}}|shdtal}}) {{M|spell damage|x}} in 1-second intervals, starting immediately upon debuff application, over a max {{ValueColor||{{#expr:{{#var:Aether Remnant type1 value5}}+1}}|shd}} damage instances.
**** Prioritizes enemy creeps without the debuff within its search range.
***** The debuff is reapplied on valid enemy creeps once the previous debuff expires.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_void_spirit
data.bio_loc:
Not even the other spirits claim to understand the mind and machinations of the eldest amongst them, Inai the Void Spirit. Privy to secrets that would shatter a mortal mind, the Void Spirit observes the workings of the universe from an unknowable vantage, choosing to let carefully groomed servants do his bidding -- only emerging from his Hidden Temple into the material plane when he deems that he alone can steer the course of reality along its proper path.

With an expansive perspective on existence, Inai is focused intently on a point in time beyond which he cannot see, when the fabrics of multiple realities are fated to collide. Now he steps from the aether to personally resolve the battle of the Ancients and prepare his allies for what he views as a greater conflict to come.
data.hype_loc: Privy to secrets that would shatter a mortal mind, the Void Spirit emerges from his Hidden Temple to stand guard over multiple areas of the battlefield at once. Able to step into and out of the mortal plane at will, he easily outmaneuvers opponents to strike from wherever he desires, calling upon the powers of the aether to shield him in times of need.
data.npe_desc_loc: Steps in and out of the mortal plane to strike his foes

abilities.name: void_spirit_aether_remnant
abilities.desc_loc: Void Spirit dispatches a remnant to the target location. The remnant stands watch over the region, facing the direction of his vector. When a unit crosses its gaze, the remnant pulls it in and damages it.
abilities.lore_loc: Inai exists far beyond the scope of a single point in space and time.
abilities.shard_loc: Creates an additional watcher path that rotates around the remnant.  The remnant now provides True Sight, and no longer triggers on creeps, instead dealing %creep_damage_pct%%% damage to them every second in both paths. Does not reveal wards.

abilities.name: void_spirit_dissimilate
abilities.desc_loc: Void Spirit temporarily fades into the aether, creating a number of portals through which he can reassemble himself. Upon exiting a portal, he damages all enemies in the area.
abilities.lore_loc: Inai much prefers to observe our plane free from the confines of corporeal form.
facets_loc: Upon exiting Dissimilate, Aether Remnants are created at the %aether_remnant_count% portals furthest from Void Spirit. No effect if reassembling from the center portal. Remnants face towards the center portal and have reduced pull duration and damage.

abilities.name: void_spirit_resonant_pulse
abilities.desc_loc: Void Spirit wraps himself in a protective shield that absorbs physical damage and emits a single damaging pulse around him. The shield gains increased damage absorption for each enemy hero the pulse hits.
abilities.lore_loc: Inai never hesitates to shroud himself in the essence of his true self when forced to interact with the mortal plane.
abilities.scepter_loc: Causes Resonant Pulse to silence and gain %max_charges% charges.
facets_loc: Resonant Pulse creates a larger all damage barrier instead of a physical barrier.

abilities.name: void_spirit_intrinsic_edge
abilities.desc_loc: Void Spirit gains %damage_stat_bonus_pct%%% more attack damage per point of each attribute, and %secondary_stat_bonus_pct%%% more HP regen from Strength, attack speed from Agility, and mana regen from Intelligence.

abilities.name: void_spirit_astral_step
abilities.desc_loc: Void Spirit tears a rift through the astral plane to appear at the target location, attacking all enemies along the path. This attack inflicts a void mark that slows for %pop_damage_delay% seconds and then detonates.
abilities.lore_loc: A small step for Inai creates great devastation on the mortal plane.
notes_loc: Astral Step attacks do not cleave.
